The execution failed due to schema key mismatches in the assumptions dictionary and formatting discrepancies in the summary report.
The test_schema_and_assumptions failed because the output used keys like 'patients' and 'fills_45' instead of the required 'patients_per_medication' and 'fills_per_year_45_day'. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the summary text used '$27000.00' while the verifier expected the comma-formatted string '27,000.00'. Avoid omitting thousand-separators in the final text output and ensure all dictionary keys strictly match the expected schema in /tests/test_outputs.py.
